agents do not touch content/manifest.js, content/manifest.json or

APPLY AFTER al10: al11 is the ELEVENTH region of the aeneis track and must
follow al1..al10 in the manifest's regions array — js/app.js regionIndex()
reads that order and feeds it to the phase engine as the ONE difficulty
input (DESIGN §6). al6, al7 and al8 are authored by a parallel agent; if
they have not landed when this is applied, HOLD al11 rather than inserting
it early, which would tune it as if it were an earlier liber.
al11 is a PROBĀTIŌ liber (kind: 'probatio', boss id b_al11) with TWO
phases: transitus (hp 5 / 45 s) then sententia (hp 5 / 55 s). The crossing
is FIRST and shorter, which is the liber's own shape (the girl's life
begins with a river crossing and ends with words said about her). Legacy
single-phase tuning in the content file is hp 10 / 100 s. bossMinMs 15000
matches l2/l3/al1..al5/al9/al10.
The transitus phase uses wall: 'harundo' and NOT 'murusAquae'. That is
deliberate and must not be 'fixed' at integration: murusAquae is Historia
Sacra's Red Sea actor and the Aeneis track does not borrow another track's
sign. content/aeneis-al3.js already ships wall: 'mountain', so a non-water
wall is precedented and js/probatio.js takes any registered actor name.
The sententia phase declares its own `items` (6, hand-authored per
AUTHORING-BRIEF 'Boss clamor/sententia items'), so js/probatio.js never
reaches its derivation fallback. The transitus phase draws its words from
the liber's own vocabulary, as it does everywhere else. Nothing here for
rules.php to know.
quizKey carries the same three keys per row as al1-al5, al9 and al10:
rules.php stores {q, a}, and `correct` is always 0 against the boss.quiz
order in content/aeneis-al11.js. Region id 'al11', not 'l11' — rules.php
keys regions in one flat namespace (see a-l1.reg.json). NOTE: 'al11' must
not be matched by any prefix rule written for 'al1'; check that pair
explicitly if rules.php does prefix matching anywhere.
al11 is a NEW region: its content id IS its progressId, so it needs no
entry in rule_region_aliases().
XP mirrors al1-al5, al9 and al10 exactly.
